sloka: हा राम राम अनुज हा हा वैदेहि तपस्विनी ।न माम् जानीत दुह्खेन म्रियमाणम् अनाथवत् ॥२-५९-२७॥
transliteration: hā rāma rāma anuja hā hā vaidehi tapasvinī ।na mām jānīta duhkhena mriyamāṇam anāthavat ॥2-59-27॥

translations.english: Otherwise if (you think) the mightyarmed (Rama) has gone too far then quickly put me in the chariot, and show me Rama (Carry me to him).
